title: The growth tick's foreground tool call is SIGKILLed at ~420s, so a 480s producer budget always loses the render
evidence: SOURCE: the 20:20 EDT tc-growth-harness-brain tick (job 43b0d5c4446d) reported in its own words that its first sync_cadence was SIGKILLed at 420s despite being instructed to use a 600s tool timeout and SYNC_BUDGET_SECONDS=480 -- 'ComfyUI completed 2 renders (35-step + 25-step) but neither became a post; RenderSalvage recovered 0 (the producer was killed before it saved the images). That's ~2 renders of paid GPU work lost -- the exact failure the budget was added to prevent, recurring because the budget (480s) exceeded the real ceiling (~420s).' Independent evidence in the repo: run 480 (created 2026-09-22T00:01:20Z) was left non-terminal with all three jobs terminal -- 7564 failed (torch OOM), 7565 COMPLETED at 00:09:22Z with its image on disk and no Photo row, 7566 failed (ComfyUI HTTP 500) -- and was only released by ReconcileStaleRuns at 00:39:25Z: the producer died mid-run and the render it paid for never became a post. A budget guard cannot protect against a wall it does not know about: the prompt mandated 480s, the kill lands at ~420s, so the guard never gets to fire. NOT a GPU problem -- the tick held a clean claim and released it ('clean -- port closed, GPU idle', VRAM 612 MiB).

notes.note: FIXED (operating agent, 2026-09-22 00:5xZ). Root cause: the tick's foreground tool call is SIGKILLed at ~420s however large a timeout is requested (600s was requested), while the prompt mandated a 480s producer budget -- so the producer was always killed mid-render instead of stopping cleanly, and the engine's own guard (MEASURED_RENDER_SECONDS=300) never got the chance to fire. FIX: the tc-growth-harness-brain cron prompt (43b0d5c4446d, ~/.hermes/profiles/turbo-carnival/cron/jobs.json) now runs SYNC_BUDGET_SECONDS=360, and the measured ceiling is written INTO the prompt so the next agent cannot raise it back: 360 is the largest budget that leaves margin under ~420s, and it still permits exactly one render per tick (the engine refuses to start a render with <300s left). jobs.json backed up first to ops/backups/cron_jobs_pre_sync_budget_360_20260922T0045Z.json. VERIFIED: jobs.json re-parsed as valid JSON, 5 jobs intact, schedule (0 * * * *) and model unchanged, and the budget line re-read from disk ('SYNC_BUDGET_SECONDS=360 bundle exec rails "growth:sync_cadence[Sarah]"'). NOT fixed here: WHY the ceiling is ~420s -- that is Hermes tool-runtime behaviour outside this repo; sizing the budget to the measured wall is the robust direction and needs no upstream change. FOLLOW-UP SIGNAL: the 21:00 EDT tick's output must show the 360 budget and a clean 'Budget: stopped after Ns' stop with no mid-render kill; if it still shows 480, the gateway has not re-read jobs.json. The OOM class that killed run 480's first render is fixed separately by commit 6a01bb6 (--reserve-vram 5).
